task_title: checkpoint에 solver와 필요한 auxiliary states, optimizer state, scheduler/projection state, RNG, effective source, configuration fingerprint를 보존한다

solver_scenes: cpml: tests/test_differentiable.py::project(steps=13), 2D 16 x 15, CPML on every wall, float64, epsilon 1.7 (E, H and 16 psi segments)
faces: tests/test_pmc_general.py::scene with walls (pml, pmc), (pmc, pml), (pec, pmc), 10 x 10 x 6 cells, float64, voxelized diagonal epsilon (E, H, psi segments, stored E and H face banks)
ade: the cpml scene through StreamedDispersiveSimulation with two poles (E, H, psi segments, P and Q banks in the x-first slab layout)
physics_configuration.policy: slab width 4 (3 for faces), temporal depth 3, checkpoints 1, local checkpoints 1, host banks, CPU tiles, restart_every_blocks 1
physics_configuration.optimization: DensityParameterization 16 x 15, density mode, truncate filter radius 0.15 um, beta 1 advanced to 2 at the third iteration, eta 0.5, float64; Adam lr 0.05; objective sum over monitors of a torch.rand weight times the squared signals; four iterations with a journal per iteration and a design checkpoint per update; the interrupted run raises after the twelfth transpose (third iteration, two transposes done)

reference_method: behavioural: the host state tuple built independently by _StreamedExecution.host and advanced two blocks by the slab operator; the uninterrupted optimization run in the same process with the same seed

observables.name: record_arrays
observables.definition: the array descriptions of the forward record after two blocks against the host state tuple

observables.name: restored_state
observables.definition: difference between the arrays loaded from the record and the state reached by advancing the host state two blocks

observables.name: history_agreement
observables.definition: difference of objective, gradient norm, beta, random weight, final design and Adam moments between the resumed and the uninterrupted optimization

observables.name: refusal
observables.definition: the state named by the ValueError of a checkpoint lacking it

acceptance_limits.solver_states: the forward record holds exactly len(host.state())+1 arrays: E, H, one psi per CPML segment, every stored E and H face bank, and for ADE the P and Q banks, each with the state's shape, dtype and byte count and a 64-character SHA-256; loading the record reproduces the two-block state bitwise; the forward resume and the backward resume reproduce the uninterrupted signals and gradients bitwise (rtol 0, atol 0)
acceptance_limits.optimizer_states: the resumed optimization reproduces the uninterrupted history bitwise on CPU: objectives, gradient norms, beta, the torch.rand weights, the final design and the Adam exp_avg, exp_avg_sq and step
acceptance_limits.named_states: DesignCheckpoint carries iteration, parameters, optimizer, projection, rng, waveform, fingerprint and history; a checkpoint lacking any one of them is refused with that name; a checkpoint written for another plan or other options (restart_key differs), another effective waveform, a damaged file (checksum or byte count) or another filter configuration is refused with the cause named
acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: bitwise equality on CPU (stricter than proposed_thresholds discrete_dimensionless_fp32); counts are exact
